purpose: Teach: 歌唱/夏季/航行/美的/現世/国防総省/パルス/生産物

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、歌唱大会の不正を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So this case—the fraud at the singing competition—the police are handling it, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal tone. Genuine curiosity without urgency. Careful phrasing, like he's checking his understanding. Steady eye contact, waiting for confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、夏季の盗難多発期も警戒されますね
lines.en: The police are also monitoring the summer theft spike, aren't they?
lines.style: Professional but warm. A small nod of agreement. Clear articulation, measured pace. The tone of someone familiar with seasonal patterns, sharing information naturally.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密漁船の航行記録を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this case—the illegal fishing vessel navigation records—the police are handling that too, aren't they?
lines.style: Same measured curiosity as before. Slight pause before 'illegal fishing.' Thoughtful, methodical. The voice of someone building a pattern, testing connections.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行の美的なパターンも分析されますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police are also analyzing the patterns in the crime methods themselves, aren't they?
lines.style: Collaborative and steady. A small lift on 'analyzing'—he's engaged now. Clear diction. The warmth of someone working through something together with another person.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現世利益を装った詐欺を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So this case here—the fraud disguised as divine blessing—the police are handling that as well, aren't they?
lines.style: Slight shift to concern now, though still measured. Gentle emphasis on 'divine blessing.' Slower pace on that phrase, recognizing its deceptiveness. Still formal, but with an undercurrent of seriousness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、国防総省との連携事案もされますね
lines.en: The police are coordinating with the Ministry of Defense on those cases too, aren't they?
lines.style: Factual, professional. The note of scale—this is bigger than local. Steady delivery, no dramatization. The voice of someone who understands jurisdiction and protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、無線パルス信号の暗号解読を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: And this case—the encrypted radio signal decryption—the police are working on that, aren't they?
lines.style: Technical precision entering his voice. Slight tension on 'encrypted'—this is specialized work. Careful, deliberate pacing. The tone of someone aware he's in deep water.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、生産物の偽装事件も扱われますね
lines.en: The police are also handling the product fraud cases, aren't they?
lines.style: Close and direct now. Slightly quieter than before. The formality dropping just a touch. Eye contact steady, but the sense of moving toward the end of a long list. Tired but focused.
